note: Evidence strength is a judgment (ASSUMED). Evidence from other places is analogy, not proof of effect in Alviso.

levers.name: Community benefit agreement (binding, enforceable)
levers.description: Binding agreement with residents/nonprofits: funding, monitoring, local priorities, no NDAs.

evidence.claim: Brookings argues CBAs are necessary for data centers
Lancaster PA draft CBA includes closed-loop cooling requirement
QTS announced $28.75M community investment, Blakely GA (developer-announced)
Amazon says it will invest $1B in data-center communities and drop NDAs amid backlash (headlines)

levers.caveat: Mostly developer-announced or draft terms; no verified case here of opposition dropping. Money alone failed elsewhere (HN 49318835: landowners refused $26M).

levers.name: Recycled-water or closed-loop/air cooling commitment
levers.description: Contractual zero or low potable water use; matches San Jose draft standards.

evidence.claim: San Jose draft standards require recycled water or air/closed-loop cooling
St. Louis panel approved with closed-loop, air-cooled chillers condition
Festus MO plan smaller with closed-loop cooling, company says shaped by community feedback
Google pushing water standards amid backlash (headline)

levers.caveat: Becomes table stakes if the Dec 2026 standards pass; value as differentiator drops. Alviso drought concern is real but site-level water data not collected here.

levers.name: Waste-heat reuse to district/community facilities
levers.description: Feed recovered heat to district heating, housing, or community buildings.

evidence.claim: Ericsson/Fortum Kirkkonummi: waste heat covers ~20% of district heat network (~1,000 homes)
Equinix/A2A Milan: ~225 GWh/yr heat into district heating
Microsoft notes many DCs are too far from communities for heat reuse to pay off
r/SanJose commenter praises a local heat-to-homes project (unverified project)

levers.caveat: No heat network near the Alviso/wastewater site is known; evidence is European. Needs a heat offtaker (ASSUMED absent). KQED coverage did not mention heat reuse.

levers.name: Surplus / backup power sharing and grid-support commitments
levers.description: Offer backup generation or flexible load to relieve local grid stress; cost-allocation guarantees so residents do not subsidise upgrades.

evidence.claim: CPUC Rule 30: applicants pay upfront for transmission upgrades
SB 57 orders CPUC study of cost shift to residential ratepayers
Ratepayer cost debate dominates national discourse (HN headlines)
r/SanJose commenters fear data centers raise local bills

levers.caveat: Backup-generator sharing conflicts with the generator-testing and air-quality limits; diesel sharing likely unacceptable to residents.

levers.name: Local hiring and training pipeline
levers.description: Hiring/apprenticeship commitments for Alviso and North San Jose residents; union labor agreements.

evidence.claim: Union laborers and business groups supported San Jose standards

levers.caveat: Few permanent jobs per MW; opposition has not engaged on jobs. Only KQED evidence of labor support; no outcome evidence from elsewhere gathered.

levers.name: Noise and backup-generator limits beyond code
levers.description: Cap generator testing (draft 25 h/yr vs state 50), noise monitoring, lower-noise cooling, setbacks.

evidence.claim: San Jose draft: generator testing 25 h/yr vs 50, noise and sewer monitoring, 1,500 ft notice
Jefferson County CO 1,500 ft setback (snippet)
Virginia neighbours irked by data center noise (headline)

levers.caveat: Cheap for developer; but may be mandated by standards anyway, so only exceeding them counts as an engagement.

levers.name: Burrowing-owl habitat mitigation and monitoring
levers.description: On-site or adjacent habitat protection and surveys beyond fee payment; independent monitor; early engagement with Audubon.

evidence.claim: Audubon sued San Jose over Alviso Topgolf owl-habitat mitigation (2017)
Burrowing owl designated CESA candidate species in Oct 2024

levers.caveat: Evidence is for litigation risk, not for a mitigation that defused it. No filing on the Prologis site found.

levers.name: Early notice and direct engagement with Alviso residents
levers.description: Developer/city outreach before entitlement; wider notice radius; transparent reporting.

evidence.claim: Residents say city has not contacted them about Prologis project
Draft standards extend mailed notice to 1,500 ft
Amazon says it no longer uses NDAs (headline)

levers.caveat: Costs little; the stated complaint is process, not only impacts.
